`M$Mode` bit layout:

| Bit | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Read access |
| 1 | Write access |
| 2 | Executable access |
| 6 | Single-user (non-sharable) |
| 7 | Directory-file access |

The kernel validates a caller's requested open mode against `M$Mode`.
